## Notes

- **Job description and write paths.** `references/lanes/skills.md`; content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` (`--repo=owner/name` with `=`; `--ack-through=ID` from the LAST comment page for a body refresh; every minute stamp must be `{{NOW}}` or `{{WAS:…}}`, a `WAS` later than the act's clock is refused) / `label-write.mjs` / `issue-create.mjs` / `close-cards.mjs` (`--stateless` after the state label is stripped; `--no-skip-pr-referenced` when a closed PR still references the card) and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --actions-file` (`issue_patch`, `pr_ready`, `pr_draft`, `automerge_enable`, `automerge_disable`, `pr_request_reviewers`). Route: `dispatch` (relay `fleet-write.yml` on `main`). ⛔ No MCP write. An accepted dispatch with no run is UNCONFIRMED (exit 6) — ⛔ never re-run blind; go read the card.
- **Landing.** Non-governed = CI all green + the seat's at-tier read, through the queue (`check-expected-skips --pr N` exit 0, `check-governed-merges --pr N`, relay `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`). **Arm only after `mergeable_state` reads `clean`.** Tier S = at-tier `## Contract review` PASS in seat then the same flip. Tier H (`skills/**`) = four-piece set (contract review on the PR, ACCEPT on the card, `needs-user-decision` + 维护者速读 on the PR, review requested from `os-zhuang` and `hotlong` via relay `pr_request_reviewers`), the PR waits draft; on an authorized APPROVED the seat lands unless the approver already did (this shift they did: ready, arm, enqueue in 2 minutes); close-out is the seat's either way. `check-expected-skips` can answer exit 3 ("no reading") while a check-run is still being created on the head — re-run a minute later.
- **Liveness baseline** (`mode:subagent`): dispatch → draft PR 25–31 min (one-file skill fixes at tier) and 71 min (an `M` probe with a 30-family gate pass and a 13-minute battery); a patch round 25 min; a container restart kills in-flight subagents but leaves worktrees, the shared checkout and the scratchpad on disk — re-dispatch from the worktree, never commit its leftovers from the seat; a running process in the worktree is positive evidence. Queue latency this shift: 24–85 min.
- **Platform readings (kept):** an approver's `auto_merge_enabled` on a ready PR entered the queue 71 s later on one PR and 4 minutes later on the other (`added_to_merge_queue` is the proof; the lag is not a stall and needs no re-arming); the fleet-write relay has a write-pace budget of 40 writes per trailing hour per token (`write-pace.mjs --status`; exit 10 = refused, nothing sent, reopens when the oldest write ages out) — a seat landing several PRs in one hour plans its writes and folds them; an approver may APPROVE and flip ready without arming — then the seat strips `needs-user-decision` and arms (`unstable` from a stale non-required run does not block the queue); the merge queue builds refs for only its first five entries, so a queued PR beyond them shows no `gh-readonly-queue` ref and no merge-group run until it moves up — the timeline's `added_to_merge_queue` without `removed_from_merge_queue` is the proof; `check-expected-skips` answers exit 3 while a check-run is still being created on the head (re-run a minute later); the session classifier refused one pre-merge `needs-user-decision` strip and never a post-merge one; a container restart kills in-flight subagents but leaves worktrees, the shared checkout and the scratchpad on disk — re-dispatch from the worktree; the shell's working directory resets between tool calls; a relay write takes 40–90 s end to end; the 5-hour usage wall terminates in-flight subagents; `git-history.mjs touch` takes `--path=FILE`; the container's `gh` reports its token invalid while REST through the proxy works — read with `curl`; claim and body text go through quoted-heredoc files; MCP multi-label `list_issues` is a UNION — REST `labels=a,b` for AND; fetch `+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main` before `check-harness-current.mjs`; `git merge-tree --write-tree BASE HEAD` answers conflict-freedom without a worktree; the shared checkout needs one `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` before `check-expected-skips.mjs` runs; `actions/runs?branch=QUEUE_REF` is unreliable — read `actions/runs?event=merge_group` pages (one file per page) grouped by `head_branch`; a merge-group `CI` run can conclude `failure` with every job `success` when its aggregator job is never created.
